Guardrails (photo_* rules) require that user photos are never trained on: use Gemini only with a paid, billing-enabled key, set Mistral's training opt-out, and do not send BODY photos to any provider whose dataPolicy is 'unclear' until it is clarified.
Mistral's hosted Small, Large and Ministral models are now open-weight; they are listed here because Forge reaches them through Mistral's hosted API.
Anthropic is called natively; every other provider through an OpenAI-compatible base URL.

models.notes: Commercial API inputs/outputs are not used for training by default (Privacy Center). Forge calls Anthropic natively; JSON via output_config.format (json_schema). Prices are for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; a prompt over 100K pays $0.50/$2.50 for the whole request, so keep COACH context under 100K. Max output 128K. Adaptive thinking, default effort medium; thinking:disabled allowed only at effort high or below. Sampling params return 400 on API version 2026-10-21. No server-side refusal fallback on Haiku 5.5. Cache hit $0.01/M. Anthropic positions it for high-volume extraction and classification. OpenRouter lists anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 at the same price.

Commercial API inputs/outputs are not used for training by default (Privacy Center). Forge calls Anthropic natively; JSON via output_config.format (json_schema). Max output 128K. thinking:disabled returns 400 (use between_tools or low effort). Forced tool_choice any/tool returns 400, so use output_config.format for JSON. Cache hit $0.10/M. Safety classifiers can end a turn with stop_reason refusal; Forge must handle it.

Commercial API inputs/outputs are not used for training by default (Privacy Center). Forge calls Anthropic natively; JSON via output_config.format (json_schema). Anthropic's default recommendation. Thinking cannot be disabled; default effort medium. Forced tool_choice any/tool returns 400. Cache hit $0.20/M; fast mode $8/$40. Likely more than FOOD_PHOTO/LABEL need; a candidate for PROGRAM and COACH if cost allows.

models.notes: Singapore price for prompts up to 256K ($1.20/$4.80 above). jsonSchema is 'partial': the structured-output doc lists the Qwen3.7-Plus series for response_format json_schema (strict), but requests with image or video input fall back to json_object, so the JSON shape is not enforced for FOOD_PHOTO, LABEL or BODY; structured output is unsupported in the US (Virginia) region. Weight openness is not stated (the Plus series has been API-only; unverified). Data retention policy: business data (inputs, outputs, files) is not used to train or improve foundation models without separate consent; inference logs kept up to 30 days; ZDR available per workspace for supported models. API keys are bound to their region. OpenRouter lists qwen/qwen3.7-plus at $0.32/$1.28 with structured_outputs.
